Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> confesses she tripped while chasing the butterfly.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、蝶を追いかけていて、足を踏み外したらしい。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> avoue avoir trébuché en poursuivant le papillon.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> gesteht, dass sie beim Verfolgen des Schmetterlings gestolpert ist.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> confiesa que tropezó mientras perseguía a la mariposa.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Diz-se que <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tropeçou enquanto perseguia uma borboleta.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สารภาพว่าเธอสะดุดขณะไล่ตามผีเสื้อ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thú nhận mình đã vấp ngã khi đuổi theo con bướm.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने कबूल किया कि वह तितली का पीछा करते हुए ठोकर खा गई थी।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Even the butterfly needs to rest, it seems.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 蝶にも休息が必要なのかもしれないね
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 看来蝴蝶也需要休息吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 看來蝴蝶也需要休息吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Même le papillon a besoin de se reposer, semble-t-il.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Sogar der Schmetterling braucht wohl eine Pause.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Parece que la mariposa también necesita descansar.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Parece que a borboleta também precisa descansar.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ดูเหมือนว่าผีเสื้อก็ต้องการพักผ่อนเช่นกันค่ะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Có vẻ như cả bướm cũng cần nghỉ ngơi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: लगता है तितली को भी आराम की ज़रूरत है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Then, do you want to try again?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: じゃあ、もう一度やってみる？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Sollen wir es dann noch einmal versuchen?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ถ้าอย่างนั้น ลองอีกครั้งไหมคะ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Vậy, chúng ta thử lại nhé?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: तो, क्या तुम फिर से कोशिश करना चाहती हो?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Le entregué una Poción de Vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มอบโพชั่นพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa ra một Bình Thuốc Sức Sống.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 다음을 위해 심기일전하는 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(을)를 데리고 훈련장을 빠져나왔다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I left the training grounds with <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, who seemed determined to succeed next time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 次に備えて気持ちを新たにした<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>を連れて、訓練場を後にした。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我带着下定决心要雪耻的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>离开了训练场。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 我帶著下定決心要雪恥的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>離開了訓練場。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: J'ai quitté le terrain d'entraînement avec <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, qui semblait déterminé à réussir la prochaine fois.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ich verließ den Trainingsplatz mit <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, die entschlossen schien, es beim nächsten Mal besser zu machen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Salí del campo de entrenamiento con <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, quien parecía decidida a tener éxito la próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Saí do campo de treinos com <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que se preparou para o próximo desafio.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฉันออกจากสนามฝึกพร้อมกับ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ดูมุ่งมั่นว่าจะทำให้สำเร็จในครั้งหน้า
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Aku meninggalkan tempat latihan bersama <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, yang tampak bertekad untuk berhasil lain kali.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tôi rời khỏi sân tập cùng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, người đang dốc hết sức cho lần tới.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मैं <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के साथ प्रशिक्षण मैदान से निकल गया, जो अगली बार सफल होने के लिए दृढ़ संकल्पित लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 어쩐지 하고 싶은 말이 있는 듯한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(을)를 데리고 훈련장을 빠져나왔다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I left the training grounds with <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, who looked like she wanted to say something...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: どうやら言いたいことがありそうな<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>を連れて、訓練場を後にした。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 我带着似乎还有话想说的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>离开了训练场。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 我帶著似乎還有話想說的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>離開了訓練場。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: J'ai quitté le terrain d'entraînement avec <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, qui semblait hésiter à dire quelque chose...
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Ich verließ den Trainingsplatz mit <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, die aussah, als wollte sie etwas sagen...
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Salí del campo de entrenamiento con <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, quien parecía querer decir algo...
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Saí do campo de treinos com <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, que parecia ter algo a dizer.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ฉันออกจากสนามฝึกพร้อมกับ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ดูเหมือนอยากจะพูดอะไรบางอย่าง...
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Aku meninggalkan tempat latihan bersama <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, yang sepertinya ingin mengatakan sesuatu...
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tôi rời khỏi sân tập cùng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, người có vẻ ngập ngừng muốn nói điều gì đó...
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मैं <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> के साथ प्रशिक्षण मैदान से निकल गया, जो कुछ कहना चाहती हुई लग रही थी...

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 열의를 불태운 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 오늘의 훈련을 끝까지 해냈다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Fired up with determination, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> saw her training through to the end.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 気合に満ちた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、今日のトレーニングを最後までやり抜いた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 充满干劲的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>完成了今天的所有训练。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 充滿幹勁的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>完成了今天的所有訓練。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Pleine de détermination, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a mené son entraînement jusqu'au bout.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Voller Entschlossenheit zog <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ihr Training bis zum Ende durch.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Con renovada determinación, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> completó su entrenamiento de hoy.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Um calor de entusiasmo, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> completou o treino de hoje até ao fim.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ด้วยความมุ่งมั่น <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้ฝึกฝนจนจบ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Dengan tekad membara, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menyelesaikan latihannya sampai akhir.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Với quyết tâm sục sôi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã hoàn thành buổi tập của mình đến cùng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: दृढ़ संकल्प से भरी <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने आज का प्रशिक्षण अंत तक पूरा किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 잔뜩 풀이 죽은 채로 훈련을 이어나갔다…
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> carried on with training, looking completely dejected...
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、すっかり落ち込んだままトレーニングを続けた…。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a continué l'entraînement, l'air complètement abattue…
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> setzte das Training fort, völlig niedergeschlagen…
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> continuó con el entrenamiento, luciendo completamente desanimada…
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ฝึกต่อไปด้วยท่าทางหดหู่…
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> melanjutkan latihan, tampak sangat patah semangat…
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tiếp tục tập luyện, trông hoàn toàn chán nản…
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> पूरी तरह से निराश दिखते हुए प्रशिक्षण जारी रखा…

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est égayée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ficou animado ao receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tươi tỉnh hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> औषधि मिलने के बाद खुश हो गई।
